name: Gizmos, snapping and viewport tools
body:
# Gizmos, snapping and viewport tools

Everything drawn in and driven from the 3D view: richer gizmos, snapping that can be configured, a grid and view
options, camera presets, a view cube and a toolbar overlay. All of the maths stays in `crates/editor-core` (unit tested);
the viewport is placed from `.chaos` through the new `<viewport>` primitive (`GAME-F02-T05`).
